0022600092.text: Both the Phoenix Suns and Portland Trail Blazers open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, and the Suns are missing Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, and Luke Kennard, who is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery. Phoenix won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but Portland won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Suns a 40% chance to win.
